headline: HOU @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 4.33 at TOR 4.57, with a projected total of 8.90. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TOR: HOU moved -0.27 runs while TOR moved +0.38, changing the projected margin by -0.66 runs. NRFI probability rose +7.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Mike Burrows has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yordan Alvarez, George Springer, Kazuma Okamoto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Christian Vázquez, Christian Walker because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
